name: @repo/rust
description: Workspace-wide Cargo checks that deliberately remain one invocation: rustfmt, cargo-deny, coverage, docs, and release builds. Per-crate test and clippy tasks live in crates/* so turbo --affected can select the changed Rust crates and their dependents.

scripts.lint: bun run lint:fmt && bun run lint:deps
scripts.lint:deps: cargo deny --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml check bans licenses sources
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit:all && bun run test:doc:all
